# Open Bank Foundation
> The open framework for banking in the AI era.

Open Bank Foundation is a proposal for a shared, open-source framework for banks:
~30 production-shaped banking microservices, multi-cloud substrate (cloud-agnostic, OpenTofu + ArgoCD),
AI-native governance with policy-gated agents and human-in-the-loop controls, and banking-grade patterns
(ledger, SEPA, SWIFT, idempotency, outbox, audit) shared in the open.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://open-bank.tech/): Manifesto, framework overview, and co-founding proposal
- [Platform](https://open-bank.tech/platform.html): Live governance (DORA/PSD2/GDPR), FinOps, BCP, AI governance, cloud architecture
